priority: Live current 3 Kings SOP and six central rules > user-authorized scope/RBAC/RLS > guarded adapter > vendored upstream method
enforcement: agent-guidance-only; not an enforced server-side SOP gate, not a ChatGPT global plugin

selected_skills.name: systematic-debugging
selected_skills.use: Only on bugs or conflicting source/sync evidence: identify root cause before proposing a fix.

selected_skills.name: verification-before-completion
selected_skills.use: All 17 commands: report actual evidence and readback rather than unverified Done.

selected_skills.name: test-driven-development
selected_skills.use: Only approved application logic/bugfix changes: failing test, minimal code, green regression.

selected_skills.name: requesting-code-review
selected_skills.use: Code changes and PR readiness: review diff, scope, security and regression before proposing merge.

selected_skills.name: using-git-worktrees
selected_skills.use: Code edits: isolate by existing branch or supported local worktree; do not mutate main.

selected_skills.name: writing-plans
selected_skills.use: Complex, multi-file code changes: plan smallest viable implementation and verification.

selected_skills.name: writing-skills
selected_skills.use: Skill/manifest maintenance only: validate new or changed agent instructions.
